resources.string: Opens the AT4K launcher whenever the Amazon home screen comes to the front. It is told which app\'s screen is in front, never what is on that screen, and it keeps nothing and sends nothing anywhere.
Pick the screensaver the TV should use.
This app is not allowed to change the screensaver yet. Run firetv-launcher on your computer to finish setting it up.
The TV did not save that screensaver. Your previous selection is still active.
Update Fire TV UI with Fire TV Toolkit before choosing a screensaver here.
